Super Coupon Club

Wishlist NOW!

ABOUT

Join Victoria and her rag tag group of underground coupon counterfeiters collectively known as the Super Coupon Club as they take on the new Corporate Super Mart! 

CREDITS

Art, Programming, Audio, Design, Everything Else -  Gizmo199 & Nicolai
"interac machine beeps modem dial tear paper receipt.flac" - kyles
Various Samples and Foley - Cymatics Echo Soundworks Fesliyan Studios
Input - Juju Adams Offalynne
Scribble - Juju Adams
Cheese Palette - Gors


This game was made in a month for the Coolmath Game Jam 2026 you can play it now on coolmathgames.com!

WobbliestGem2 days ago(+1)

This game is really fun, I'll definitely be playing it when it fully releases.

Found a way to go on infinitely:
Transaction 1:
 - 1 "Infinity Day" (+1 Day)

 - 2 "Bulk Pricing" (+1 mult on all percentage coupons)

 - 2 "Rebate Slip" (20% off total)

Transaction 2:

 - 1 "Refresh" (Reset all single-use coupons)

 - 2 "Bulk Pricing" (+1 mult on all percentage coupons)

 - 1 "Rebate Slip" (20% off total)

 - 1 "Stock Clearance" ($10 off total)

By the time "Rebate Slip" triggers in transaction 2, it's been affected by "Bulk Pricing" 5 times, which makes it do 100% off the total, and then "Stock Clearance" just makes it so I actually make a profit.
